description: Open a model in the Convexity app (starting the app when nothing is running) and work on it from here on. Name it, with project when the name repeats across projects, or pass its id; list_projects lists them. When the name is in several projects and the user named none, ask which before opening either. path imports a model file on this computer (a Convexity .db, a PyPSA NetCDF .nc or a Convexity workbook .xlsx) into the project as a new model. create makes a new, empty model called name (ask the user for a name if none was given) in the project, with its time axis (naive UTC) and the default carriers, and opens it.

create.description: A new, empty model called name.

name.description: The model's name as the app shows it.

path.description: Absolute path on this computer to a .db, .nc or .xlsx: imported as a new model (with create and no app: the .db the new model goes in).

project.description: The project holding it (name or id). Default: the open project.

name: open_in_app
